item.tib: dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu bskor las 'ban zlog gsang ba'i ti ka zor 'phyong
item.coloph: de ltar dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrab gab pa dgu bskor (skor) las 'ban zlog zor gyi ti ka 'di yang / dpal snya chen mchog gi gar rol sa gsum las 'gran zla bral cing / ka dag bon gyi skur mngon par brnyes pa'i khyung dkar grub pa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi yang srid kun mkhyen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin grags pa'i gser khrir skyong ba 7spyang 'phags rin po che mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags mchog gis bka' gsungs spyi bor phebs pa dang*/ ma zad rig pa'i zlos gar la mi rmongs pa'i drang srong nam mkha' tshul khrims dang / stag rgod drang srong dbang 'dus gnyis nas yang yang du bskul ba la brten nas/ bka' gsung spyi phebs (phab) gyen ldog ma nus pa'i kho bo/ gsang bdag dpal bo chen po'i mngon zhal yang yang du mjal ba'i sdom brtson tha shal ba/ mi ngan ming che khyi la seng ge'i ming du grags pa'i zol po te (gte) rgan pa bla mi'i cha tsam gtogs pa'i 7g.yung drung thogs med rtsal lam/ tshe dbang bde chen snying po sdom pa gsum gyi rjes su 'breng tshul ba des/ bon gyi 'dus gnas chen po dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du smin grol bka' lung 'chad pa'i thun mtshams su/ dkar chag yi ger btab nas phul ba'o//
